options.name: ARMCO Pure Iron (Grade 2 / Grade 4)
options.supplier_or_grade: AK Steel International / Cleveland-Cliffs (ARMCO is a trade name; comparable low-carbon magnetic irons exist under ASTM A848, not read)

key_specs.value: 820 +/- 20 (reducing or inert atmosphere; dry N2, Ar or vacuum acceptable)
100-150 C (bake 177-260 C after anneal to stabilise)
not stated in accessed source (textbook ~770 C: verify)

options.satisfies_requirement: No requirement frozen yet (HW-MC-13 TBD). Candidate data cover HW-MC-13's 'sourced B-H and saturation' item only at room temperature; temperature dependence, outgassing and O-exposure data NOT in the source.
options.oxygen_compatibility: Bulletin claims 'adhering, protective layers of scale' vs normal steel (qualitative, air, no temperature/time); 'excessive oxidation is injurious to the magnetic qualities'. No O/O-plasma data. Needs AOL-EX-02 / HW-MC-06 coupons and likely a coating (open).
options.availability_notes: Bulletin lists hot-rolled sheet samples (2 and 3 mm) and forged/bar use; no lead times published.
options.limitations: Machining stresses degrade permeability -> anneal after machining (bulletin). Tends to smear in turning. Bs vs temperature not given. Ferromagnetic coupon affects B(z) (HW-MC-06).

options.name: Hiperco 50A (FeCo-2V)
options.supplier_or_grade: Carpenter Technology; ASTM A801 Alloy Type 1, MIL A 47182 (datasheet statement)

key_specs.quantity: B at 16 kA/m, bar, std magnetic anneal

key_specs.value: 857-871 C, 4 h, dry H2 or vacuum

options.oxygen_compatibility: Datasheet: laminations deliberately oxidised in O-bearing atmosphere at 300-500 C to grow an insulating oxide -> the alloy oxidises readily in that range (inferred from the datasheet coating note). No plasma/AO data.
options.availability_notes: Forms manufactured: strip, plate, bar, billet. Lead times not published. Export-control: none stated in the accessed sheet.
options.limitations: Bar properties markedly softer-magnetically than strip (Hc 209 vs 30 A/m). Low ductility; must be annealed in H2/vacuum after machining. Cost/Co supply not published here.

options.name: VACOFLUX 50 (49Co-49Fe-2V)
options.oxygen_compatibility: Not stated in the source.
options.availability_notes: Solid rods 12.5-182 mm diameter; others on request. No lead time published.
options.limitations: Brittle (<3 % elongation); H2 anneal required; same Co-alloy supply considerations as Hiperco (not quantified).

options.name: 430F Solenoid Quality (ferritic 17Cr free-machining)
options.supplier_or_grade: Carpenter; ASTM A838, A314, A581, A473, A582 (listed)

key_specs.quantity: Hc full anneal (845 C, dry H2)

options.oxygen_compatibility: Corrosion rating 'Humidity: Excellent' (room-temperature aqueous scale); no high-temperature oxidation or plasma data.
options.availability_notes: Bar rounds, billet, wire; annealed ground bar >= 9.53 mm dia.
options.limitations: Bs ~1.56 T (~27 % below pure iron) -> more ampere-turns. 0.25-0.40 % S free-machining additive: vacuum suitability (sulfide outgassing) is not addressed by the source (verify). Not recommended for welding (datasheet).
